text:
Hello, QA requires the source scaffold in `src/` to run the e2e tests. Please create the following minimal files so the dev server (`npm run dev`) can start:

- src/index.ts
- src/app.ts
- src/webhook.ts
- src/gateway.ts
- src/admin.ts

Once the files are added and `npm run dev` is running locally, the Playwright tests can hit the endpoints. After server is ready, let me know so I can run the tests and report results.
